source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Press "F12" when the hint shows up during POST. Check the information and see if SUT could boot into BIOS setup menu.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. POST information (include BIOS version and release date) should be readable and correct.
2. SUT should boot into BIOS setup menu successfully.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly identifies physical pre-OS action.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds platform-specific F12 target and exact-menu evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify that F12 at POST reaches the source-required BIOS Setup target and displays readable/correct BIOS version and release date.
original_method: Confirm the board-specific F12 mapping, use physical console input at the displayed hint, capture the exact target and values, and exit safely to normal boot.
manual_activity: A human must press F12 in the transient POST window and visually identify the exact target and version/date; SSH cannot prove this path.
required_inputs: Expected BIOS version/date and target screen
safety_requirements: Do not assume common F12 boot-menu or Setup behavior.
Do not flood keys or change settings.
Stop on unexpected target or failed recovery.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare mapping/version baselines and evidence checklist.
Analyze supplied screen evidence and boot context.
Report without claiming physical action or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve window and press F12 at the hint.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: ordinary SSH cannot prove F12 pre-OS behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain physical F12 interaction and verify the board mapping first.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: F12, hint, source Setup target, version/date and 30/30-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a continuous timestamped hint-to-F12-to-target sequence with displayed values and safe exit.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact board/BIOS after mapping confirmation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds mapping validation and traceability without automating the core.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Boot manager and BIOS Setup are not interchangeable.

project_override_considerations: If F12 intentionally opens another target, document the approved expectation and actual menu; do not silently call it BIOS Setup.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source internally requires F12 BIOS Setup entry; platform mapping is a required input, not a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is clear and manual; missing mapping/equipment is readiness.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains F12 mapping safeguards and MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates readiness, human observation and verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents copying F2/F11 behavior onto F12 without proving its exact target.
independent_technical_reasoning: F12 is independently platform-mapped; physical input and visual target are core, so MANUAL ONLY applies.

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeatedly reboot, flood F12 or choose another target automatically.
